trap.label: falso amigo
trap.wrong: She is antisocial because she prefers to stay home.
trap.right: She is unsociable because she prefers to stay home.
trap.why: Em português “antissocial” costuma significar “tímido/reservado”. Em inglês, antisocial é prejudicial aos outros; para quem prefere ficar só, use unsociable ou introverted.

fix.wrong: The doctor gave me an anti-biotic for the infection.
fix.right: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for the infection.

fix.wrong: Use antibacterial soap for kill germs.
fix.right: Use antibacterial soap to kill germs.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com um adjetivo anti-: “soap against bacteria” → “___ soap”
Reescreva com anti-: “a drug against viruses” → “an ___ drug”
